sn51.29:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe || ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn51.29:1.2: Katamā nu kho bhante iddhi || katamo iddhipādo || katamā iddhipādabhāvanā || katamā iddhipādabhāvanāgāminī paṭipadā ti || || 3--6.
sn51.29:2.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anekavihitam iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti eko pi hutvā || pe || yāva Brahmalokāpi- ||
